SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.category_id as categoryId, a.organizer_id as organizerId, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, a.location, a.max_participants as maxParticipants, COALESCE(reg_count.current_participants, 0) as currentParticipants, a.status, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.requirements, a.participation_conditions as participationConditions, a.contact_info as contactInfo, a.emergency_contact_name as emergencyContactName, a.emergency_contact_phone as emergencyContactPhone, a.created_time as createdTime, a.updated_time as updatedTime, a.deleted, COALESCE(ac.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, COALESCE(u.username, '未知') as organizerName FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id, COUNT(*) as current_participants FROM activity_registration WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY activity_id ) reg_count ON a.id = reg_count.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = #{status}
AND a.status IN (2, 3, 4)
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND a.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%')
AND a.start_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTimeBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time <= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.category_id as categoryId, a.organizer_id as organizerId, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, a.location, a.max_participants as maxParticipants, COALESCE(reg_count.current_participants, 0) as currentParticipants, a.status, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.requirements, a.participation_conditions as participationConditions, a.contact_info as contactInfo, a.emergency_contact_name as emergencyContactName, a.emergency_contact_phone as emergencyContactPhone, a.created_time as createdTime, a.updated_time as updatedTime, a.deleted, COALESCE(ac.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, COALESCE(u.username, '未知') as organizerName FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id, COUNT(*) as current_participants FROM activity_registration WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY activity_id ) reg_count ON a.id = reg_count.activity_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
